datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on December 27, 2022
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of December 27, 2022, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20221227]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (Sentinel-1 SAR) was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map the actual extent of flooding across the Philippines caused by tropical cyclones as of December 27, 2022. The processed data was delivered as both raster (PNG) and vector (shapefile) formats representing observed flood boundaries.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing and analysis to map actual flood extent from Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar imagery during the December 2022 typhoon event in the Philippines.
